jobs.description:
This organization is a leading player in the manufacturing industry, helping production companies efficiently process, move and manage raw materials and bulk goods. With deep technical expertise, it develops and delivers innovative solutions that make manufacturing processes smarter, safer, and more reliable. From concept and design to implementation, customization is at the heart of every project, ensuring each solution is tailored to the customer's specific needs. Through a strong focus on quality and innovation, the company enables its customers to improve performance and achieve sustainable growth. Employees are encouraged to take initiative, collaborate, and continuously develop their expertise. The company culture is defined by entrepreneurship, craftsmanship and a shared passion for technology. With a forward-looking mindset, the organization continuously invests in new technologies and sustainable processes. In doing so, it contributes every day to a stronger, more efficient and more innovative industrial sector.#MANUFACTURING #PRODUCTION #ENGINEERING #TECHNICAL #TECHNICALSALES #SALESENGINEER #SALES #BUSINESSDEVELOPMENT #BUSINESSMANAGER #STRATEGIC #SCANINAVIA #BELGIUM #ANTWERPEN #OOST-VLAANDEREN

Jobomschrijving

• Develop and implement a strategic growth plan for the Scandinavian market.
• Analyze market opportunities, build a strong network, and identify new business opportunities.
• Coordinate and support local agents to drive market growth and commercial success.
• Establish clear structures, processes, and action plans to ensure efficient market development.
• Coach and train agents to effectively communicate the technical value and benefits of our solutions.
• Build and maintain long-term relationships with customers, partners, and key stakeholders.
• Work closely with agents to create strong first introductions with potential customers and build trust through both commercial and technical expertise.
• Translate customer needs into commercial opportunities and transfer them to sales and engineering teams for further development.

• Support and initiate sales and marketing activities to further strengthen market presence.
• During the initial phase, travel regularly throughout Scandinavia to gain a deep understanding of customers, agents, and market dynamics. Over time, the role will evolve toward strategic coordination and follow-up from Belgium.

• Proven experience in business development, account management, market development, or commercial project coordination within a technical or industrial environment.
• A technical degree or equivalent experience within the manufacturing industry, process industry, or industrial technology sector.
• Able to combine strategic thinking with a hands-on approach and turn opportunities into tangible results.
• Strong relationship builder with the ability to connect stakeholders and coordinate complex collaborations.
• Highly organized, takes ownership, and follows up projects in a structured and goal-oriented manner.
• Excellent commercial, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate others.
• Comfortable working in an international environment, fluent in English, willing to travel and knowledge of Dutch, French, German, and/or a Scandinavian language is considered a strong asset.

Our client is a well-established international company based in Brussels, operating in the natural health and wellness sector.

Jobomschrijving

As a Business Controller your responsibilities are:

• Prepare and analyse financial reports to support decision-making.
• Monitor budget performance and provide variance analysis.
• Collaborate with departments to ensure accurate financial forecasting.
• Support the preparation of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and internal policies.
• Identify areas for cost optimisation and process improvements.
• Assist in financial planning and strategic initiatives.
• Provide insights and recommendations based on data analysis.

A successful Business Controller should have:

• A degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field.
• Proficiency in financial analysis and reporting tools.
• Strong knowledge of budgeting and forecasting processes.
• Attention to detail and a results-oriented mindset.
• Ability to work independently and collaboratively with cross-functional teams.
• Good understanding of financial regulations and compliance requirements.
• Fluency in English.

jobs.occupation: Power Electronics and Motor Control Engineer
jobs.description:
Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

At Traxial, we are designing the next generation of high-performance, energy-efficient systems. We’re looking for a PE & Motor Control Engineer to join our innovative team and play a pivotal role in creating systems that push boundaries in robotics and industry.
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to design, develop, and optimize high-efficiency power electronic & motor control systems. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed requirements and functional designs for power electronic circuits & motor controllers.. 
   
 

•  

Perform simulations, testing, and validation to ensure system performance meets all requirements. 
   
 

•  

Troubleshoot and resolve issues during the design, prototyping, and manufacturing phases. 
   
 

•  

Ensure products are compliant with relevant standards for power drive systems. 
   
 

•  

Stay informed about the latest trends and developments in power electronics in robotics & industrial applications. 
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

A Master's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

Minimum of 3 years of experience in power electronics & circuit design.
   
 

•  

Strong knowledge of inverters and motor controllers.
   
 

•  

Experience with PCB design tools such as Kicad, Altium or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Experience with electronic circuit simulation software such as LTSpice or equivalent.
   
 

•  

Understanding of thermal management and electromagnetic compatibility (EMC).
   
 

•  

Previous experience in model-based design and/or FPGA platforms will be considered a plus.
   
 

•  

A team player with excellent problem-solving skills and a proactive mindset.
   
 

•  

Fluent in English, both written and spoken.

You will work on the production line.

• You fill food products.

• You check if the weight is correct.

• You take products off the production line.

• You place products in boxes.

• You put the correct labels on the products.

• You check that everything is correct.

• You keep your work area clean and tidy.

• You follow the rules for hygiene and food safety.

• You work together with your colleagues to make sure the work is finished on time.

We are looking for someone who:

• speaks Dutch. Good French or English is also possible

• likes to work and stay active : likes working with their hands

• can work accurately

• follows hygiene rules

• has no problem working in a cold environment of 0°C to 4°C

• has no problem with physical work

• is flexible when the work takes a little longer. It can happen that the work is not finished at the planned end time. In that case, you continue working until everything is finished;
is willing to work full-time.

• Experience in a production environment is a plus, but not required. No experience? No problem, you will learn the job on site.

Experience with an electric pallet truck or forklift is a plus. A valid certificate is an extra advantage.

Working hours

Monday to Thursday: 07:30 – 16:00

Friday: 07:30 – 13:30

For some positions, for example in the kitchen, the working day can start at 03:00 and finish at 11:30. Interested in this option? Let us know.

Are you flexible and able to work on Saturdays when needed? That is definitely a plus.

Your team and your responsibilities:

Team/division description

You will be part of Operations Excellence Division, Health, Safety & Talent Engagement department.

Our Mission is to cultivate a safe workplace environment and to foster a workplace culture that prioritizes safety, well-being, growth, and continuous improvement of our most valuable asset – our people.

Your responsibilities

· Support in the Health & Safety team in Diest ensuring legal requirements are met

· Support in the implementation, execution & monitoring of the required HS standards

· Drive safety at the workplace by making daily rounds and periodic audits incl. creation and reporting-out findings & prevention measures.

· Providing advice on wellbeing domains such as workplace safety and hygiene.

· Third party performance management (follow-up on contractor performance towards a sustainable safety adherence).

· Following-up and investigating occupational accidents and incidents.

· Participating in drawing up and maintaining a dynamic risk management system.

· Drawing up risk analyses and being involved in commissioning into service.

· Supervising the application of H&S regulations, work instructions and reception in the warehouse.

· Screening new products – chemical products.

· Co-lead the emergency preparedness activities.

Your profile

· Education level: Prevention advisor level 1 or 2

· You are fluent in Dutch & English (TME's business language)

· You can demonstrate relevant experience as a prevention advisor, preferably within a large organization;

· You enjoy working in a team and understand that diverse personalities & perspectives provide better solutions.

· You see challenges as a development opportunity and demonstrate flexibility when required by the team or business.

· Open to get & give feedback through frequent and efficient alignment-meetings

· Professional, effective and respectful communication is required, both verbally and written (e-mail/phone/meeting). You speak & write Dutch & English fluently.

· Analytical mindset – Able to understand partners to propose solid solutions

· Functionally you have a strong knowledge of Office 365 applications (excel, access, PBI)

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a 
Mechanical Design Engineer – Robotics and help shape compact, high-performance actuators for robotics. You’ll translate demanding motion requirements into practical, manufacturable mechanical designs. 
 

This is what you’ll do: 
 
 

•  

Design and develop mechanical solutions for robotic systems, from concept through prototype and production. 
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T. 
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification to ensure performance, reliability, and durability. 
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications. 
   
 

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous design improvement. 
  

Who are we looking for? 
 
 

•  

Master’s degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience. 
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in the design and development of robotic systems, actuators, or precision motion systems. 
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools. 
   
 

•  

Strong understanding of robotics system requirements and performance specifications, with the ability to translate payload, speed, torque, force, power, accuracy and duty cycle into mechanical design requirements. 
   
 

•  

Strong awareness of the latest trends and technologies in robotics, with a good understanding of emerging robotic architectures, actuation technologies, and motion solutions. 
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium. 
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

Welcome to Traxial: Where big ideas start small (but mighty)
 

Join Traxial as a Mechanical Design Engineer and take ownership for Precision Gearboxes . You'll work from concept to prototype and production, combining detailed mechanical design with hands-on validation.
 

This is what you'll do:
 
 

•  

Design and develop precision gearboxes for new product applications, from concept through prototype and production.
   
 

•  

Design mechanical components such as gears, shafts, bearings, housings, seals, and other transmission elements.
   
 

•  

Create detailed 3D CAD models and 2D manufacturing drawings, applying relevant industry standards and GD&T.
   
 

•  

Perform and support mechanical calculations and design verification.
   
 

•  

Work closely with suppliers and subcontractors on gearbox components, manufacturing processes, tolerances, materials, and specifications.
  

•  

Support prototype builds, testing, troubleshooting, and continuous improvement of gearbox and actuator designs.
  

Who are we looking for?
 
 

•  

Master's degree in Mechanical or Electro-Mechanical Engineering, or equivalent experience.
   
 

•  

At least 3 years of professional experience in gearbox, drivetrain or precision mechanical component design.
   
 

•  

Proficient in Siemens NX, Teamcenter PDM, or similar CAD/PDM tools.
   
 

•  

Good knowledge of materials and manufacturing processes for gearbox components, including gear machining, heat treatment, tolerancing, and design-for-manufacturing principles.
   
 

•  

Strong analytical skills and experience performing mechanical calculations, such as gear sizing, shaft strength and bearing selection.
   
 

•  

Experience in Romax, KISSsoft or similar packages for gear calculation is a plus.
   
 

•  

This position requires existing work authorization in Belgium.
   
 

•  

A team player with a can-do mentality, creative mindset, and fluent English.

As a production worker early shift, you play a key role in the production process of meat products. Together with your colleagues, you help ensure everything runs smoothly and efficiently.

Your responsibilities include:

 
• Supplying the production line with meat products.
 
• Trimming and cutting meat where necessary to ensure every product meets quality standards.
 
• No knife experience? No problem! Full training is provided on the job.
 
• Assisting with the loading and unloading of goods.
 
• Supporting different departments such as production, packaging, and dispatch.

The variety of tasks makes the role of production worker early shift both dynamic and rewarding.

Do you enjoy hands-on work and staying active throughout the day? Then you could be the production worker early shift we are looking for.

 
• Physically fit and comfortable with manual work.
 
• Willing to work with meat products.
 
• Comfortable working in a chilled environment.
 
• Able to work independently as well as part of a team.
 
• Flexible with early morning starts and shift schedules.
 
• As a production worker early shift, you can communicate in Dutch, English, French, and/or Romanian.

For an international company active in the telecom sector and based in Zaventem, we are looking for a detail-oriented Sales Administrator to support the end-to-end post-quotation sales process.

In this fully back-office role, you ensure that sales orders are processed accurately and efficiently from validated quotation through to invoicing. You act as a key coordination point between Sales, Operations, and Finance, making sure all data in the ERP system is correct and up to date.

Your tasks as Sales Administrator:

• Process and manage sales orders accurately in the ERP system (Odoo)
• Handle requests from customers and Sales Managers regarding order changes
• Verify pricing, contracts, and commercial data for accuracy
• Prepare order confirmations, contracts, and other administrative documents
• Collaborate with Sales, Operations, and Finance to ensure smooth order processing
• Follow up on orders from confirmation through to invoicing
• Resolve invoicing issues in coordination with the Finance team
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date customer data in CRM/ERP systems
• Identify and correct discrepancies in orders, pricing, or documentation
• Support continuous improvement of sales administration processes

The ideal profile as Sales Administrator:

• Bachelor's degree in business administration, Management, or equivalent experience
• Minimum 2-4 years of experience in sales administration, order processing, or back-office support
• Strong attention to detail and high level of administrative accuracy
• Experience with CRM/ERP systems (Odoo is a plus)
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple orders simultaneously
• Clear and professional communication skills in a cross-functional environment
• Fluent in German and English (written and spoken); additional languages are an asset
• Experience in telecom, IT, or B2B technical environments is a plus

This large Belgian company plays a key role and manages an extensive and technically complex network. Behind the scenes, high-performing and reliable IT systems ensure that operational processes run safely and efficiently. Within this business-critical environment, significant investments are being made in modern software development and sustainable IT architecture.
You will join an experienced team operating in an Enterprise environment where quality, collaboration, and long-term vision are central.

Jobomschrijving

You will work as part of a team on the further development and optimization of applications using a modern version of .NET & Angular, with a strong focus on performance, testing, and clean code. You ensure stable communication between various internal systems.
Beyond your operational involvement, you will also have input into the broader technical direction. Within the team, you will have the opportunity to initiate technical improvements and actively contribute to building a robust and future-proof IT environment.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in IT (or equivalent through strong experience)
• Senior professional experience with .NET
• At least a first hands-on experience with Angular
• You're a pragmatic team player
• You work in English and understand Dutch & French

•  15 years of experience in IT

Our client, located in the Kortrijk region, is a global producer of textile machinery.

No two days are exactly the same. As a CNC Turner/Miller, you can expect the following responsibilities:

You set up and operate CNC turning and milling machines with the required precision. Throughout the production process, you monitor the automated machines closely and make adjustments whenever necessary.

Quality is key: you check finished parts and ensure they meet the required standards. You also review measurement results, identify deviations and communicate them to the responsible person.

By monitoring the automatic operation of the production cell, you help prevent downtime and ensure a smooth production flow.

 
• 
You have a strong technical interest and work with precision.

 
• 
You have an eye for quality and detail.

 
• 
You have experience with Fanuc and Mazak systems.

 
• 
You have previous experience in the metal industry as a turner/miller.

 
• 
You enjoy working in a team, while also being able to work independently.

 
• 
You are willing to work in a two-shift system: 5 a.m. – 1 p.m. and 1 p.m. – 9 p.m.

 
• 
You have a good knowledge of Dutch, French or English to follow the training successfully.

Are you willing to help us accelerate towards a carbon neutral economy? Are you passionate about energy and do you have the potential to grow with us towards the best energy utility ? Are you an ENGINEER? Then ENGIE, leader of the Energy Transition, wants to meet YOU!
 
ENGIE is committed to promote Equal Opportunity employment. We pro-actively foster an inclusive environment that not only embraces but celebrates diversity. Our goal is for all employees to experience a real sense of belonging. We aim to provide them with a safe and inclusive working environment in which they feel empowered to thrive and excel.
At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century!
 

Jobomschrijving

• For the operations & maintenace of our power plants or for our renewable operations (wind mills/hydro/batteries), we are mainly looking for industrial and civil engineers in electro-mechanics, mechanics, chemistry, physics or electronics who are fluent either in Dutch/French and English.
• For our engineering firm (Tractebel) we are looking mainly for Dutch speakers with:
• a master in civil engineering and a focus either on infrastructure projects or structural engineering
• a master in engineering with professional experience in road, water and/or civil engineering
• For our sales and energy management teams we are looking for either Dutch/French people with fluency in English and who have power market understanding and good analytical, data and AI skills.

You recognise yourself in the following behaviors:

• genuine care for the safety and wellbeing of yourself and your colleagues
• open & curious to understand other’s perspectives even when your own's are challenged
• ready to prioritise and simplify processes
• able to request and give feedback
• make decisions & deliver results
Research shows that men apply when they met 60% of the requirements while women only apply when they are convinced they meet 100%. However, we are looking for potential, not perfection. So apply today!

As an Air Export Agent, you play a key role in the smooth handling of international air freight shipments. You coordinate export operations from start to finish, ensuring accurate documentation and timely execution. With a strong focus on quality and compliance, you translate regulations and procedures into efficient daily practices. Y

As an Air export agent you're responsible for the following tasks:

• Ensure smooth and timely freight process flow
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into our operating system
• Track and trace Air export files as required
• Ensure timely delivery of freight to customers for export shipments
• Ensure arrival notices are communicated to overseas and customers
• Ensure accurate and timely client and vendors billing.
• Interact with our customers in arranging their international shipments, meeting customer service standards
• Ensure all customers' standard operating procedures are followed and updated
• Meet KPI standards, as per the company procedures
• Keying of air import shipment according to the KPI s and customer's requirements.
• Release files according to KPI and customer requirements in compliance with all rules and regulations
• Overseas communications, timely responses to emails and requests (internal and external)

The Air Export Agent we're looking for has the following profile:

• 2 years related experience
• Bachelors degree
• Understanding of air documentation process is needed
• Effective interpersonal skills, including proven abilities to listen, comprehend, effectively communicate clearly and concisely to obtain positive results
• Pro-active, strong organizational skills
• Good computer skills (Excel, Word)
• IATA certification (preferred)
• Fluent in English and a good level of Dutch
• Eligible to work in Belgium
